annotations.title: What is new on every channel since last time

description: USE THIS INSTEAD OF POLLING. One call returns what arrived since your last call across every connected channel: comments and replies (Threads, including replies to the brand's own replies; TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn Pages, Facebook, Instagram), DMs, mentions, reviews, Instagram collab invites and keyword-watch matches, as counts plus the items. It reads no platform (Hermoso checks the channels itself every few minutes, once per brand, whoever asks), so it is free, fast and never counts against any limit. Pass back the `cursor` it returns as `since` next time. The first call starts watching the brand: what is already there is not 'new', only what arrives after. Each item carries the id and the reply tool to answer it (reply_to_thread, reply_to_inbox_item, respond_instagram_collab_invite). To have Hermoso PUSH each item to you instead, connect a webhook and choose these events with set_alert_events (inbox, mentions, reviews, collabs, keywords); keyword watches are set with set_watch_keywords.

limit.description: items per page (1–200, default 50); counts always cover everything new

since.description: the cursor the previous whats_new returned (wn_…); omit on the first call
